mapper.select: select c.*, b.title as book_title, b.cover_image, b.price, b.condition as book_condition from cart c left join book b on c.book_id = b.id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.create_time desc
select * from cart where user_id = #{param1} and book_id = #{param2}
mapper.insert: insert into cart(user_id, book_id, quantity) values(#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: update cart set quantity = #{quantity}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from cart where user_id = #{userId}
